title: Zesty Dense Ukrainian Turkey Neck Stew
description: A hearty and rich Ukrainian stew made with turkey neck, perfect for a date night dinner, and can be adapted to be vegan friendly by substituting the traditional sour cream with a vegan alternative.
instructions: In a large pot, heat the oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes, and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the turkey neck, paprika, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
Pour in enough water to cover the ingredients and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until the meat is tender.
Stir in the vegan sour cream and serve hot.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
